# Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights — facts

> Source-anchored units about Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights: 19 across 4 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## How it works

- [statement] Atlas queryShapeHash identifies the newer query shape used for query statistics; it is distinct from planCacheShapeHash, formerly queryHash. Do not equate these identifiers when correlating observability data with plan-cache diagnostics. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-shapes.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/analyze-query-shapes-with-mongodb-datadog

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] On MongoDB 8.x, Atlas collects at most 100 reads per second per host and excludes writes; on 9.0+, its default is random sampling of 1% of reads and writes. Values describe collected operations, so upgrades can change totals without workload changes. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/mongodb-atlas
- [statement] Datadog query-shape metrics expose samplingstrategy and samplingrate. The rate_limited strategy reports samplingrate=0; sampled collection uses a fraction such as 0.01 for 1%. Zero therefore must not be interpreted as a random sample fraction. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/mongodb-atlas · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] A local-shard $lookup can increment foreign-collection namespace latency and operation counts without generating a foreign-collection slow-query log. SERVER-98528 documents this observability mismatch and attaches a reproducer. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-98528
- [statement] Datadog exports query-shape metrics under mongodb.atlas.querystats, including execution counts, document examination and working time. MongoDB documents queryshapehash as the correlation tag for Atlas UI, slow logs and API lookups. (medium confidence) — https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/mongodb-atlas · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/analyze-query-shapes-with-mongodb-datadog

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Query Shape Insights groups structurally similar operations and ranks shapes by total execution time; Namespace Insights compares collection-level latency. Together they locate expensive workload patterns and affected collections. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md, https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/introducing-query-shape-insights-in-mongodb-atlas, https://www.mydbops.com/blog/unveiling-expected-features-in-mongodb-8-0
- [statement] Query Shape Insights requires dedicated M10+ clusters running MongoDB 8.0+. The documented window is seven days, with up to five shapes charted together. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights
- [statement] Namespace-level metrics support comparing affected collections. Mydbops independently describes namespace-level Query Insights visibility; its 2024 preview is historical evidence, not confirmation of the current interface. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://www.mydbops.com/blog/unveiling-expected-features-in-mongodb-8-0
- [statement] Namespace Insights excludes time-series collections and hides collections using Queryable Encryption. Automatically selected top namespaces can change with the time window; missing samples may be interpolated and drawn with dotted lines. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights
- [statement] Namespace Insights total latency and operation count are rates. Average latency uses differences in cumulative duration and operation count over a ten-minute interval. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights
- [statement] The Query Shape Insights summaries API deprecates P50/P90/P99 execution-time series and fields as potentially inaccurate. SERVER-126327 attributes incorrect percentiles to calculation from lastExecMicros and requests native execution-time histograms; avoid treating those legacy values as reliable distributions. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2025-03-12/operation/operation-listgroupclusterqueryshapeinsightsummaries · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-126327
- [statement] The query shape and namespace dashboards provide host/node, shard and interval filters and expose aggregate query shape or collection statistics. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/api/doc/atlas-admin-api-v2/2025-03-12/operation/operation-listgroupclusterqueryshapeinsightsummaries
- [statement] Query Shape Insights requires dedicated Atlas M10+ clusters running MongoDB 8.0 or later. Namespace Insights also requires M10+. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md, https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/introducing-query-shape-insights-in-mongodb-atlas
- [statement] Query Shape Insights exposes execution counts, examined/returned document ratios and execution-time trends, with application and driver metadata for workload attribution. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/introducing-query-shape-insights-in-mongodb-atlas
- [statement] Query Shape Insights helps identify expensive query shapes and provides a pivot to Query Profiler with collection and operation-type filters. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/introducing-query-shape-insights-in-mongodb-atlas
- [statement] Displayed query-shape totals represent collected operations. A sampling-policy change during an 8.x-to-9.0 upgrade can change totals without a workload change; infrequent shapes can be absent. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/mongodb-atlas
- [statement] Namespace Insights offers total and average latency, P50/P95/P99 latency, operation counts, and read/write/command filters. Its documented average uses differences in cumulative times and counts over a ten-minute interval. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights
- [statement] Query Shape Insights execution time includes getMore processing and excludes client waiting time. Datadog working_millis_sum_total uses milliseconds, while Atlas UI execution-time descriptions use microseconds; normalize units before comparison. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/mongodb-atlas
- [statement] The documented query shape and namespace dashboards list aggregate workload statistics; their metric inventories do not list an explicit replanReason field. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/query-shape-insights.md · keywords: Atlas Query Insights: Query Shape Insights and Namespace Insights · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/namespace-insights.md, https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/introducing-query-shape-insights-in-mongodb-atlas
